title: Monthly Transaction CSV Export for Merchant Portal
summary: Allow merchants to export monthly settlement and transaction history as UTF-8 CSV files up to 50,000 rows.

title: Legacy Basic-Auth Session Handler
summary: Maintain username/password session cookies with 24-hour TTL for merchant dashboard login.

title: PostgreSQL Read-Replica Routing for Reporting Queries
summary: Route analytical queries to read replica to reduce primary DB CPU utilization during peak settlement windows.

title: Merchant Webhook Delivery with Fixed 3x Retry
summary: Retry failed outbound payment webhook notifications 3 times at fixed 60-second intervals before dropping.

title: Payment Acquirer HTTP Client Timeout Configuration
summary: Set static 30-second socket timeout on upstream payment acquirer REST calls.

title: Plaintext Session Payload Caching in Shared Redis Cluster
summary: Cache full merchant checkout payloads in Redis without field-level encryption to minimize serialization overhead.
